data.name: Madhuri
data.gender_notes: Madhuri is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Madhu’ meaning ‘honey’, ‘nectar’, ‘sweet’. In Hindu mythology, Madhuri is a name given to various goddesses, including the goddess of love and beauty, Parvati, and the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi. The name Madhuri carries the meaning “Sweetness, nectar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Madhuri usually hope their child will grow to embody sweetness, nectar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the sweetness of love, compassion, and devotion.
data.etymology: Madhuri belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweetness, nectar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madhuri total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
